# FlocknGo Events

> Discover local community flocks, social groups, workshops, and upcoming activities in India.

FlocknGo (https://events.flockngo.com) is an event and community discovery platform helping people explore interest-based social groups ("flocks"), attend scheduled activities, and connect with local organizers across India.

## Key Sections

- [Home](https://events.flockngo.com/): Discover nearby activities and featured communities.
- [Communities & Flocks](https://events.flockngo.com/flocks): Explore interest-based social groups, clubs, and meetup communities.
- [Activities & Events](https://events.flockngo.com/activities): Browse upcoming weekend events, workshops, treks, and social gatherings.

## Featured City Hubs

- [Communities in Pune](https://events.flockngo.com/flocks/location/pune): Active trekking, culture, crafts, and outdoor community flocks in Pune.
- [Activities in Mumbai](https://events.flockngo.com/activities/location/mumbai): Upcoming activities, music sessions, and social events in Mumbai.

## Supported Categories

FlocknGo hosts activities and communities across diverse interests:
- Adventure: Trekking, camping, cycling, outdoor trails, mountain escapes
- Social: Meetups, community gatherings, club hangouts, campfire nights
- Creative & Workshops: Art, pottery, crafts, design, hobby classes
- Fitness & Sports: Group workouts, runs, cycling, yoga sessions
- Music & Cultural: Acoustic jams, live performances, heritage tours
- Tech & Learning: Developer meetups, hackathons, skill-building sessions
- Culinary: Street food walks, dining experiences, cooking meetups

## Participation & Information Access

- Browsing public communities and activities is free.
- Users can view event venues, dates, member counts, and organizers directly on detail pages.
- RSVP or community membership can be initiated via the "Join Community" or "Join Activity" options.
